issues.definition: The app does not open, remains on its splash or logo screen, or never reaches a usable screen. If a sign-in screen is reached and authentication fails, use ACC-LOGIN; a crash during use is PLY-CRASH; a failed audio request is PLY-FAIL.
issues.title: App fails to open

issues.definition: Cannot sign up, sign in, authenticate, or regain access to an account. If the app never reaches a usable sign-in screen, use APP-LAUNCH.
issues.title: Sign-in failure

issues.definition: Signed-in account content, saved library, or account state is inaccessible or unexpectedly lost, without a more specific download or catalog problem.
issues.title: Account content or state inaccessible

issues.definition: A specific account access problem that does not fit sign-in or account-state loss.
issues.title: Other account access problem

issues.definition: The stated price, paywall, or plan value is the complaint, without an incorrect charge or failed entitlement.
issues.title: Price or plan value

issues.definition: An unwanted, duplicate, unexpected, or continuing payment is reported.
issues.title: Incorrect or continuing charge

issues.definition: Payment or active subscription is reported but its promised premium entitlement is not available.
issues.title: Paid benefit unavailable

issues.definition: The user reports being unable to cancel, or a cancelled plan remains active or billed; a mere intent to leave does not qualify.
issues.title: Subscription cancellation failure

issues.definition: A specific billing or subscription problem outside the price, charge, entitlement, and cancellation definitions.
issues.title: Other billing problem

issues.definition: A named or described song, artist, podcast, or catalog item cannot be found or selected because it is unavailable.
issues.title: Requested content unavailable

issues.definition: Search or discovery fails to locate content that the report does not establish as unavailable.
issues.title: Search or discovery failure

issues.definition: Recommendations, discovery suggestions, or unwanted automatic content are the stated problem, apart from a playback control failure.
issues.title: Unwanted or poor recommendations

issues.definition: Lyrics are absent, incorrect, or unavailable for expected content.
issues.title: Lyrics unavailable

issues.definition: A specific content selection or catalog problem outside the listed catalog definitions.
issues.title: Other catalog problem

issues.definition: The app stops supporting or working on the user's own phone, tablet, or operating-system version. A failure involving an external device or platform belongs to DEV-INTEGRATION; lack of customer service alone is not this issue.
issues.title: App-device compatibility failure

issues.definition: Spotify fails with an external device or platform such as a voice assistant, smartwatch, car, TV, smart speaker, or Connect target. A secondary support complaint does not replace the underlying integration failure.
issues.title: External device or platform integration failure

issues.definition: An attempted music or podcast download fails or does not complete.
issues.title: Download fails

issues.definition: Downloaded items or their list cannot be accessed or played without a connection.
issues.title: Downloaded content unusable offline

issues.definition: Previously downloaded or saved offline content disappears or is unexpectedly removed.
issues.title: Saved download disappears

issues.definition: A specific download or offline listening problem outside the listed download definitions.
issues.title: Other download problem

issues.definition: The app crashes, closes unexpectedly, or forces a device restart during use.
issues.title: App crash or forced restart

issues.definition: Requested audio does not start, stops unexpectedly, or remains blocked without a more specific background or selection issue.
issues.title: Playback fails or stops

issues.definition: A selected track or queue item is replaced by different audio or cannot be selected as intended.
issues.title: Wrong audio plays

issues.definition: Shuffle, queue order, or repeated-track selection does not follow the requested playback behavior.
issues.title: Shuffle or queue order failure

issues.definition: Audio stops or the app fails specifically when the device locks, another app opens, or Spotify moves to background.
issues.title: Background playback failure

issues.definition: Pause, skip, stop, sleep timer, track display, or other playback controls fail while audio playback is otherwise available. A failed sleep timer is a stop-control failure; reported data use is a consequence to review separately.
issues.title: Playback controls malfunction

issues.definition: Lag, buffering, audio quality, connection instability, or an app that opens but freezes, hangs, or stops responding degrades use without a crash, a named playback failure, or an app-launch failure. A crash is PLY-CRASH; failure before a usable screen is APP-LAUNCH.
issues.title: Audio, loading, or connection quality

issues.definition: A specific playback problem outside the listed playback definitions.
issues.title: Other playback problem

issues.definition: A stated request to customer support receives no answer or a materially delayed answer.
issues.title: Support does not respond

issues.definition: Support responds but repeats steps, gives an unhelpful answer, or fails to resolve the reported problem.
issues.title: Support fails to resolve

issues.definition: A needed contact route, such as phone support, is unavailable or inaccessible.
issues.title: Support channel unavailable

issues.definition: A specific customer-service problem outside the listed support definitions.
issues.title: Other support problem

issues.definition: Ad volume, timing, repetition, or interruption of free listening is the stated problem.
issues.title: Ad frequency or interruption

issues.definition: Creating, editing, organizing, or navigating playlists or saved library items fails, apart from a playback or account-state problem.
issues.title: Playlist or library management

issues.definition: A short preview or sample used while selecting or building a playlist is missing or fails.
issues.title: Song preview unavailable

issues.definition: The displayed language, translation, or localization makes the app hard to understand or use.
issues.title: Language or localization problem

issues.definition: A specific screen, control layout, or navigation path makes the app difficult to use without a more specific issue.
issues.title: Navigation or interface friction

issues.definition: A specific usability problem outside the listed usability definitions.
issues.title: Other usability problem

issues.definition: The review reports a specific privacy, security, or unauthorized-access harm that is not merely an account login failure.
issues.title: Privacy or security harm

issues.definition: A specific objection to Spotify content moderation, platform policy, or company stance is the primary complaint, without a more important product malfunction. Content simply unavailable without a stated policy objection remains a catalog issue.
issues.title: Content or platform-policy objection

issues.definition: The review expresses a complaint or departure but names no product area and gives no supported specific problem; do not infer one. A named area with underspecified failure follows the area-only rule.
issues.title: General or unspecified criticism

known_gap: app-install is not a separate issue; pilot case 29 retained DLD-FAIL
